reason: A DSH Web UI plugin that visualizes agent task status through a draggable animated pet and a floating panel with live progress, pending questions, history, and session links.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中通过可拖拽的像素桌宠和浮动任务面板展示智能体任务进度、待回答问题、历史记录及会话入口。
summaries.en: A DSH Web UI plugin that uses a draggable pixel pet and floating task panel to show agent progress, pending questions, task history, and session links.

capabilities: Reads task, goal, subagent, session, and pending-question state from the DSH web host
Displays a draggable floating task panel and animated desktop pet overlay
Polls plugin routes for task updates every 1.5 seconds
Persists up to 200 completed task records in local DSH storage
Provides deep links from task cards to corresponding sessions
